name: Metamers Rendered Differentiably (MRD)
definition: A method that uses physically based differentiable rendering to probe vision models' implicit understanding of generative 3D scene properties by searching for 3D scene parameters that are physically different but produce the same model activation (model metamers).
summary: MRD finds physically distinct 3D scenes that produce identical neural activations by optimizing physical parameters against frozen network latents, ensuring physically plausible reconstructions unlike pixel-based methods.
